correctness.rationale: Every admissible face in K_n□K_2 either chooses ≤2 vertices from each clique in distinct columns, or is a lone matching diagonal edge; a diagonal pair with any third vertex forms a connected 3-vertex induced component. The disjoint-column core D_n is the multiple chessboard complex with two row capacities (2,2). Jojić–Vrećica–Živaljević Theorem 4.4 actually applies for n≥2+2+2−1=5; D_n is pure 3D shellable, hence a wedge of β_n 3-spheres by its f-vector. Attaching n isolated one-cells to the connected core creates n free circles and gives the integral H1 label-permutation lattice with layer-swap sign. The signed fixed-face Lefschetz sum over σ cycles of length 1,2 gives truncated (1−x−y)^c1 (1−x²−y²)^c2; σ times swap admits 2- and 4-cycles yielding 1−2c2+4C(c2,2)−2c4. Independently enumerated n=5 faces f=(10,45,60,30), F2 reduced Betti=(0,5,0,1), and direct signed traces for identity/transposition/5-cycle/double transposition under both swap parities. The full n≥5 proof is not inferred from n=5.
